headline: Coffee Day Enterprises settles Rs 25 crore loan with Kemfin
hook: Debt reduction at Coffee Day Enterprises
summary: Coffee Day Enterprises has successfully settled a Rs 25 crore loan with Kemfin. This debt resolution helps the company reduce its overall liabilities. The settlement is part of ongoing efforts by the management to clean up the balance sheet. For retail investors, debt resolution lowers insolvency risk for the listed firm.
why_it_matters: Lower debt reduces bankruptcy risk for Coffee Day.

headline: Coffee Day Enterprises settles dues with Kemfin Services
hook: Debt settlement resolved at Coffee Day
summary: Coffee Day Enterprises Limited has announced a one-time settlement regarding its outstanding dues with Kemfin Services Private Limited. The company informed the stock exchanges about this resolution of liabilities. For Indian retail investors, debt resolution helps stabilize the firm's balance sheet.
why_it_matters: Debt reduction eases financial pressure on the listed firm.
